15 letters and numbers. Leave it empty if you do not have a GSTIN.

With a GSTIN, your patient bills are titled "Bill of Supply". Without it, they are titled "Final Bill". No GST is charged on treatment either way.

AuraScale Service Agreement

Before you continue, please read and accept the agreement between your nursing home and AuraScale. In short:

  • ₹4,999 per month including GST after a 15-day free trial, paid monthly by UPI; a GST tax invoice for every payment.
  • You own your patients’ data. AuraScale only stores and processes it for you, never sells it, and keeps it secure (DPDP Act, 2023).
  • Patients get WhatsApp messages only after they tap “Yes”.
  • If there is a data breach, AuraScale tells you within 24 hours and helps you inform the authorities and patients.
  • Cancel any time; access continues to the end of the paid month, and you get a full export of your data.
